description:
This solicitation will result in a firm fixed price contract for 54.00 EA with FOB Origin and I/A Origin. Contractor First Article and Production Lot Tests are required for this procurement.


Approved Source(s): ONTIC ENGINEERING & MANUFACTURING, INC/CAGE 45934; GOODRICH CORPORATION/CAGEs 6K4C8 & 13002

Part Number(s): 2012B266A


The final contract award decision may be based upon a combination of price, past performance, and other evaluation factors as described in the solicitation. A copy of the solicitation will be available via the DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS) at DIBBS RFP/IFB/Other RFQs Search Page (dla.mil) on the issue date cited. Enter the solicitation number within the search value area and click the submit button. Solicitations are in portable document format (PDF). To download and view these documents, the latest version of Adobe Acrobat Reader is required. A paper copy of this solicitation will not be available to requestors. The solicitation will be published on or about April 24th, 2026 and close on May 25th, 2026.
